subject: Novex POC: dataset & MAP exchange / usage constraints
messages:
From: Claire Johnson <c.johnson@novex.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evaluation dataset & MAP for Novex POC

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers looked promising. As discussed, we want to run a 4-week POC to validate relevance and cost. To move forward we need: a) a prompt pack (sample prompts + expected outputs), b) a small labelled test-case set we can run locally, and c) a mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out delivery milestones, acceptance criteria, and usage constraints (especially around storage/retention and redistribution).

Can Redwood provide those artifacts under a limited-use agreement? Our security team will also want to confirm we can only use the artifacts for the POC and will not redistribute them. Proposed timeline: kickoff week of 4/26, data exchange by 4/29, evaluation complete by 5/21. Does that align with your end?

If helpful I can share our security questionnaire and a short sample of the test cases.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Johnson
Director, Product
Novex AI

--

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Johnson <c.johnson@novex.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation dataset & MAP for Novex POC

Hi Claire —

Appreciate the clear timeline. We can support the 4-week POC and are prepared to exchange the artifacts under a mutual action plan that includes explicit usage constraints. Attached I've put a working MAP (MAP_Novex_Redwood_v1.pdf) and a prompt pack bundle (novex_eval_promptpack_v1.zip) as a starting point. Highlights:

- Delivery: prompt pack + testcases (redacted) delivered by 4/29.
- Acceptance: evaluation scripts + pass-rate threshold (outlined in MAP).
- Usage constraints: POC-only use, no redistribution, retention capped at 90 days post-POC unless agreed otherwise, and required deletion confirmation.
- Required items from Novex: signed MAP (DocuSign link below), completed security questionnaire, and point-of-contact for data handling.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-1327) and a shared Drive folder I created for artifacts.

Next steps: if you can sign the MAP and return the security questionnaire by 4/27 we will schedule the data exchange on 4/29. If any of the usage constraints are a blocker, flag them and we can discuss redlines.

Attachments:
- MAP_Novex_Redwood_v1.pdf (application/pdf) [attachment stub]
- novex_eval_promptpack_v1.zip (application/zip) [attachment stub]

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: evaluation dataset & MAP for Novex POC

Neha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP draft. A couple of asks from our side:

1) Security: we'll send our full security questionnaire (attached) — can your security team confirm that testcases do not contain any production PII and that Redwood will provide a deletion certificate after the retention window?
2) Escrow / escrow-like controls: for compliance we prefer the testcases to be hosted in a sandbox environment accessible only to Novex employees and Redwood engineers supporting the POC (no external contractors).
3) Usage constraints: we will not sign any clause that prevents internal troubleshooting of the testcases (i.e., we need to run edge-case repros internally), but we agree to no redistribution outside Novex.

We received the MAP and prompt pack; will review and aim to return the signed MAP + completed questionnaire by 4/27.

Attachments:
- Novex_Security_Q.pdf (application/pdf) [attachment stub]

Best,
Claire

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation dataset & MAP for Novex POC

Hi everyone — looping in Marissa from Applied ML and security reviews. A few operational questions and proposed milestone updates:

- Can you confirm the format of the testcases you want (JSONL with fields: input, expected_output, tolerance)? If Novex can share a 50-record sample that helps us verify redaction.
- Model variants: for cost/latency comparatives we'll provide two quantization profiles (fp16 and int8-quant) and one larger baseline model. Please confirm which constraints (e.g., no model weights transfer) are acceptable.
- Milestone update proposal:
  * 4/29: secure transfer of redacted testcases (we'll put them in the shared Drive folder with ACLs restricted)
  * 5/07: mid-POC checkpoint (quality metrics + tuning notes)
  * 5/21: final evaluation report and deletion certificate issued within 7 days after mutual sign-off.

Quoting Claire's note below for context:
> Neha —
>
> Thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP draft. A couple of asks from our side:
>

Marissa, can you confirm the deletion certificate process and that restricted Drive ACLs meet our compliance bar?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Claire Johnson <c.johnson@novex.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation dataset & MAP for Novex POC

Thanks for the details — I'm confirming security/legal items and finalizing the MAP language. Final notes:

- We've attached a compact testcases file and a sample prompts file for Novex to validate format.
- Deletion certificate: Redwood will provide a signed deletion certificate within 7 calendar days after mutual sign-off; the certificate will list object identifiers and retention window.
- Sandbox access: we will host the dataset in a sandbox Drive folder with ACLs limited to Novex POC participants + two Redwood SREs. No external contractors without prior written approval.
- Usage constraints (finalized):
  1) POC-only use; no redistribution outside Novex.
  2) Retention capped at 90 days after POC end unless extended in writing.
  3) Testcases and prompt pack may not be used to train service-visible models or for commercial benchmarking without explicit consent.
  4) Novex may analyze and reproduce failures internally for debugging.
  5) Any publication referencing the testcases requires Redwood pre-review (simple 3-business-day window).

Attachments provided here (stubs):
- evaluation-testcases-v1.jsonl (application/jsonl) [attachment stub]
- prompts-sample-20.txt (text/plain) [attachment stub]
- MAP_Novex_Redwood_v1.pdf (application/pdf) [updated v1 with final clauses] [attachment stub]

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/track/0A1B2C-MAP-NOVEX
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovexEval

Claire — once you countersign and return the questionnaire we will proceed with the 4/29 exchange.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
